prompt: Is "How tall are the students in my class?" a statistical question? (yes/no)
hint: Think about what you would write down if you measured everyone in the class.

hints.text: Think about what you would write down if you measured everyone in the class.
The question asks about many students, and their heights will not all match. A question whose answers vary like this is statistical.
The answer is yes, because the heights vary from student to student.

explanation: A statistical question is one that anticipates variability in the answers.
This question is about all the students in a class, and different students have different heights.
Because the data would vary, yes, it is a statistical question.

steps: Plug the result back into the question and confirm the values match.
